sc_capture: Click a row, then press the new key combination. Works with any keyboard layout.
about_description: RepoPrep cleans and flattens project folders for clean sharing — removes node_modules, build artifacts, caches and clutter while preserving your source structure. Fully local, no network calls.
mode_flatten_d: Copies all files into one flat folder with no subfolders, so the whole project lands in a single clean place.
mode_clean_d: Removes node_modules, venv, .git, build artifacts and caches. Preserves the original folder structure.
mode_scan_d: Analyzes the project and shows what would be removed. Nothing is copied or deleted.
opt_images_hint: Images are excluded by default to keep the output lightweight. Enable this if your project depends on image assets.

reset_desc: Reset the theme, keyboard shortcuts and panel layout back to their original values. Your language stays unchanged.
reset_body:
Theme, keyboard shortcuts and the panel layout will be restored to their defaults.
The language will be kept.
reset_done_body: All settings have been restored to their original values.
ext_note: Extension support is coming soon. RepoPrep currently ships with its built-in cleaning engine.
prof_note: Profiles let you save named sets of options and reuse them later. This feature is coming soon.
snp_note: Create small reusable snippets to prepend or append to your prepared projects. Coming soon.
task_note: Run pre-defined operation sequences with a single click. Coming soon.
help_report_note: Found a bug or want a feature? Open an issue on the RepoPrep repository and include the log from the Activity pane.
contact_issue_desc: Open a new issue on the RepoPrep repository and attach the log from the Activity pane.
contact_website_desc: Learn more about RepoPrep and the other Lidprex products.
contact_repo_desc: Browse the source code, read the docs and check the latest releases.
guide_note: Quick answers for the most common tasks.
guide_lang_d: Open Settings → General and pick a language from the dropdown. The change applies instantly.
guide_theme_d: Use Settings → Themes to choose System, Light or Dark. The app follows your OS automatically on System.
guide_paths_d: Click Browse next to the Source and Output fields, or drag a folder onto the card.
guide_mode_d: Flatten copies everything into one folder, Smart Clean removes clutter in place, Scan Only previews without changing anything.
guide_run_d: Press Run to start the operation or Scan for a safe preview first. Progress and results appear in the Activity log.
guide_shortcuts_d: Most actions have shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl+, opens Settings). Review or remap them in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts.
keep_desc: Smart Clean removes these individual files. Pick the ones you want to keep.
keep_empty: Scan a project to list the files that would be deleted.
contact_support_desc: General bug reports and feedback about the app itself.
legal_security_desc: Security notices and how to report a vulnerability.
